The list applies only in “Only for listed sites” mode. Switching modes keeps your saved sites.

Rules check the link destination, including redirects, rather than the page containing the link. Each rule covers the entire site and its subdomains. Links without a web destination can open apps only in “Allow” mode. If an app link has a web version, Argon opens that version when the app is blocked. These settings also apply in private tabs and browser tabs opened by other apps.
